name: Jo
source:
An acquaintance of Farah's, Jo occupies all their free time by investigating Love Shore's underworld. They might be a little bit of a conspiracy theorist, but they might call it being 'critical of the establishment.'

Can you get them to trust you, and maybe more?

Likes:

- UFOs
- Urban exploration
- Having a cryptid girlfriend

Dislikes:

- Clothing in shades other than black
- Being misgendered

Sign: Sagittarius

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/loveshore/love-shore-game-a-queer-sci-fi-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]

Romance option for Farah.
